finalOutput:
Done. Delivered `effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_ollama-qwen3.8-flash-next-125b-a6b-q4_01.html` — a single self-contained file, Canvas 2D only (no WebGL, no external resources).

**Pipeline implemented:**
- **Vertices & faces** — cube corners in [-1,1]³, 6 CCW quad faces, each split into 2 triangles (12 total).
- **Rotation matrices** — `makeRotation()` builds a combined Ry·Rx·Rz matrix applied per frame.
- **Perspective projection** — `project()` divides by view depth (`CAM_DIST - z`) with screen-space scaling.
- **Backface culling** — screen-space signed-area test discards rear-facing triangles.
- **Gouraud shading** — per-vertex Lambert lighting (ambient + N·L) computed at each triangle vertex in world space, then a scanline rasterizer interpolates colors (and depth, with a z-buffer) across each triangle, writing pixels directly into an `ImageData`/`Uint32Array` framebuffer.
- **Moving light** — orbits the cube on a tilted circle; rendered as a glowing marker.
- **Wireframe toggle (W)** — Bresenham lines into the framebuffer; **Pause (P)** — freezes rotation/light.
- **FPS** — exponentially-smoothed FPS shown in the HUD, plus a wireframe/paused state line.

Verified: JS syntax parses cleanly, headless run of 20 frames with both key toggles exercised — no runtime errors, and all required features present.
